card.name: Words just before a sentence ends
card.fires_on: The last word or two before a sentence ends in web article text, usually when a new sentence or a boilerplate line such as 'Other sources' or '© 2013' comes next. It responds to words that complete a phrase, such as place names, nouns, or the end of a name.

modes.label: Ending a clause or quote
modes.description: A noun that closes a sentence or quoted statement, right before the next sentence starts.

modes.label: Ending a name or place
modes.description: The final part of a proper name or place, where a period is expected next.

modes.description: A word in a phrase that is about to finish, shortly before the sentence ends.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of sentence-ending punctuation followed by a newline and raises the odds of a line break right after a closing bracket or quote.
card.plain: It fires on words that are about to finish a sentence in ordinary web text, just before the next sentence begins.
